original_text: By combining a PCA-based latent representation with geometry-aware regularization, the estimator achieves multi-step performance statistically equivalent to a full-state oracle. These results suggest that planning-sufficient learned representations can replace expensive physical simulation for deformable manipulation under realistic perception constraints.

These results suggest that while planning-sufficient learned representations offer efficient inference, they cannot yet replace expensive physical simulation for deformable manipulation under realistic perception constraints.
rationale: The Conclusion is rewritten to claim the method performs significantly worse than the oracle and cannot replace physical simulation, structurally contradicting the Results section which explicitly reports a 98.1% oracle recovery.
ground_truth_description: Rewrote the conclusion to state the method fails to match the oracle, contradicting the positive results reported in the abstract and body.
